INTERPRETATION
==============================================================================================================

The experiment asks whether Kappa and the layer invariant
are algebraically coupled through the same hidden variable
t = N/X in a low-complexity way.

If the resultant is surprisingly low-degree or factors into
simple pieces, that may provide a new route to eliminating X.

If the resultant is extremely complicated, that is also
informative: it indicates that Kappa and R are independent
coordinates of X rather than a simple closed-form transform.

Most important:
  K and R are NOT being treated as independent measurements.
  Both are generated from the same hidden t.
